subject: AWS Marketplace SKU packaging, metering model & partner handoff
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace SKU packaging, metering model & partner handoff

Hi team,

Following this morning's partner sync with DataWave, they asked for a compact SKU packaging that maps to their buyer personas (Enterprise, Platform, Research) and clarifies metered vs. subscription billing for our AMI/privateoffer. High-level asks:

- A single-row SKU for "Managed Inference" (metered by inference-hour) + optional "Support + Observability" subscription.
- Clear trial entitlements (14-day privateoffer with 10k inference-hour credit).
- Copy for hero and feature bullets that call out VPC & SOC2 readiness.

I've attached a first-pass SKU matrix (sku_packaging-proposal-v1.xlsx) and a short hero draft (hero_copy-sample-v2.md). Can Kim and Olga review the pricing buckets and the wording for the hero? Jonas — can you validate the entitlement mapping for private offers and marketplace private pricing? Priyom — can you flag any potential marketplace compliance flags (metering footnotes, usage thresholds)?

Goal: get these finalized by EOD Thu so we can share the updated spec with DataWave and prep the Field SellPlay for next week.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Martinez
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments: sku_packaging-proposal-v1.xlsx (excel, 120KB); hero_copy-sample-v2.md (markdown, 3KB)
From: Samira Khan <samira@datawave.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan@datawave.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace SKU packaging, metering model & partner handoff

Alex — thanks for the overview and the files. Quick clarifications from our procurement and platform teams:

1) Metering: we prefer a per-inference-hour metering SKU but need a clear maximum per-request charge cap (for bursty workloads). Can you add an explicit example (50M tokens, typical inference time) to the pricing notes?
2) Trial: 14-day trial with a 10k inference-hour credit sounds fair — can the trial be tied to a Private Offer so it doesn't trigger public billing?
3) Packaging: for our Platform team, a single managed SKU + optional add-on is easiest from a billing perspective.

Also — would you be able to share a short one-pager that our field engineers can share internally (we need security and integration bullets)?

Samira
Head of Cloud Partnerships, DataWave
samira@datawave.ai

Date: 2027-04-06T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace SKU packaging, metering model & partner handoff

Thanks Alex — reviewed the attachments. Key notes:

- Pricing buckets: I recommend three tiers (Starter, Scale, Enterprise) mapped to monthly inference-hours with a step-down unit price at each tier. Include a small per-request cap note to address Samira's concern (we'll show an example calculation in the pricing footnote).
- Trial/privateoffer: marketplace privateoffer is the correct path — it keeps the trial from appearing as a public listing charge. Ops will need the SKU alias mapping (we'll add in the sheet).
- Hero copy: tighten the headline to lead with reliability ("Predictable LLM inference, scaled for production") and a secondary line that calls out "VPC-friendly, SOC 2-ready, predictable metering". Attached a short suggested rewrite in the doc.

Next actions: Olga will validate the AMI/landing page requirements and confirm screenshots + AMI tags. Jonas please confirm the entitlement payload so our backend can map the privateoffer grant. Priyom, anything in the Marketplace ToS that blocks a metering-tiered SKU?

Kim
Senior GTM Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-07T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace SKU packaging, metering model & partner handoff

All — I validated the entitlement mapping and spoke with Infra. Summary:

- PrivateOffer trial: we can grant a 14-day 10k inference-hour credit via a Private Offer using an entitlement token scoped to the customer's account ID. Implementation notes are in the Drive link.
- Metering cap: we'll publish a pricing footnote with an illustrative cap example (e.g., 1M tokens / request upper-bound -> ~0.05 inference-hour cost cap) and show how it maps to billing lines.
- AMI/landing: Olga flagged that the AMI needs an updated launch script to expose VPC endpoint configuration by default — she'll push the AMI tag change tomorrow.

Next steps for closure: Alex to consolidate final SKU sheet and hero copy; Kim to produce the short 1-pager for DataWave field engineers; Olga to update AMI tag and share screenshot; Priyom to confirm marketplace footnote language. I can join the technical handoff call with DataWave next Tue.

Jonas
Principal Product Manager, Marketplace
